title: VTC Groups — Create — payload
description: An administrator creates a community group: the community's VTA mints the group's own DID and, where it issues credentials, the community authorises it to issue membership credentials; the group is recorded only afterwards. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

rule.description: REQUIRED for a dynamic group; refused on a static one.

issuesCredentials.description: Whether the group's DID issues its members a membership credential. Absent: true.

reason.description: Why, recorded with the change and shown to anyone who must approve it.

Response.title: VTC Groups — Create — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vtc/groups/create/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/groups/create/0.1#response.
